V2G20-1000.text: EXAMPLE [V2G20-1000] This is an example requirement introduced in this document.

atoms.notes: This is a placeholder for an example requirement and does not contain specific formal atoms.

V2G20-1001.text: [V2G20-1001] All certificate validations shall be carried out in conformance with IETF RFC 5280 and ITU-T X.509.

atoms.notes: This action ensures that both the EVCC and SECC adhere to the specified standards for certificate validation.
This invariant ensures that throughout the entire session, certificate validations are consistently performed according to the specified standards.

V2G20-1002.text: [V2G20-1002] When cross-certification is used, the certificate chain sent shall include the cross-certificate.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the condition for cross-certification being used is met.
This action specifies that when cross-certification is used, the certificate chain must include the cross-certificate.
This field constraint ensures that the CertificateChain is of type X509_CERTIFICATE_CHAIN and is mandatory.

atoms.expr: IF CrossCertificationUsed THEN CrossCertificate IN CertificateChain
atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that if cross-certification is used, the cross-certificate is always included in the certificate chain throughout the session.

V2G20-1003.text: [V2G20-1003] All certificate chains (except where a cross certificate is used) shall have a maximum length of 3.

atoms.notes: This constraint applies to all certificate chains except those involving a cross certificate.

V2G20-1004.text: [V2G20-1004] Certificates shall be issued and signed by the CA within the validity of its own certificate.

atoms.notes: Ensures that the certificate's validity period falls within the CA's validity period.
The issuer of the certificate must match the distinguished name of the CA.

V2G20-1005.text: [V2G20-1005] All certificate chains, including a cross certificate, shall have a maximum length of 4.

atoms.notes: This constraint applies to all certificate chains, ensuring their length does not exceed 4.
This constraint specifically targets cross certificate chains, ensuring their length does not exceed 4.
This guard checks if the session is ongoing and a stop condition has been met.
The EVCC sends a SessionStopReq message.
The SessionStopReason field in SessionStopReq must be set to ImmediateStop.
The SessionStopReq must be sent within the specified timeout.
Ensures that sending SessionStopReq is the next valid action in the session state.

V2G20-1007.text: [V2G20-1007] A public SECC shall send in the "ServerHello" message its own certificate chain (SECC certificate chain) including any necessary cross-certificates up to a root (excluding the root certificate itself), which shall be one of those roots previously indicated by the EVCC as being present in the EVCC.

atoms.expr: SECC shall send CertificateChain in ServerHello
atoms.notes: The SECC sends its certificate chain in the ServerHello message.

atoms.expr: CertificateChain includes SECC certificate and cross-certificates up to a root (excluding the root certificate)
atoms.notes: The certificate chain sent by the SECC must include all necessary certificates up to a root, excluding the root certificate itself.

atoms.expr: Root certificate is one of those previously indicated by the EVCC
atoms.notes: The root certificate in the SECC's certificate chain must be one of the roots previously indicated by the EVCC.

atoms.expr: EVCC has previously indicated a set of root certificates
atoms.notes: It is assumed that the EVCC has previously communicated a set of root certificates to the SECC.

V2G20-1009.text: [V2G20-1009] As soon as the SECC becomes aware of the fact that [V2G20-1413] can no longer be satisfied it shall trigger a proper schedule renegotiation procedure.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the condition specified in V2G20-1413 can no longer be satisfied.
The SECC triggers the schedule renegotiation procedure when the guard condition is met.
After triggering the renegotiation, the next allowed request from the SECC should be a ScheduleRenegotiationReq.

V2G20-1010.text: [V2G20-1010] The power values of the EVPowerProfileEntry elements shall represent the projected average target power levels.

atoms.expr: EVPowerProfileEntry.PowerValue represents projected average target power levels
atoms.notes: This atom ensures that each EVPowerProfileEntry's PowerValue field correctly reflects the projected average target power level.

V2G20-1011.text: [V2G20-1011] If a secondary actor provided a PowerSchedule, the SECC shall ensure that no power value within the PowerSchedule exceeds the matching EVSEMaximumChargePower limit.

atoms.notes: Checks if both PowerSchedule and EVSEMaximumChargePower are present.
Ensures all power values in PowerSchedule do not exceed EVSEMaximumChargePower.

atoms.expr: if exists(PowerSchedule) then forall(powerValue in PowerSchedule.POWER_SCHEDULE_ENTRY.POWER_DATA) => powerValue <= EVSEMaximumChargePower
atoms.notes: Maintains the invariant that power values in PowerSchedule never exceed EVSEMaximumChargePower throughout the session.

V2G20-1012.text: [V2G20-1012] If a secondary actor provided a PowerSchedule for discharging, the SECC shall ensure that no Power value within the PowerSchedule exceeds the matching EVSEMaximumDischargePower limit.

atoms.notes: Checks if a secondary actor has provided a PowerSchedule for discharging.
Ensures that no Power value within the PowerSchedule exceeds the EVSEMaximumDischargePower limit.

atoms.expr: if SecondaryActorProvidedPowerSchedule then forall i in PowerSchedule[i].PowerValue <= EVSEMaximumDischargePower
atoms.notes: Ensures that throughout the session, if a secondary actor provides a PowerSchedule for discharging, all Power values comply with the EVSEMaximumDischargePower limit.

V2G20-1013.text: [V2G20-1013] There shall be at least one firewall between the EVCC, which is connected to an untrusted network, and the SECC, which is connected to a trusted network.

atoms.notes: This assumption captures the requirement for a firewall between the EVCC and SECC networks.
The firewall must always be active to ensure network security.
The EVCC is assumed to be connected to an untrusted network.
The SECC is assumed to be connected to a trusted network.

V2G20-1014.text: [V2G20-1014] For security reasons the rules mentioned in Table 3 shall apply for the firewall mentioned in [V2G20-1013].

atoms.notes: This atom assumes that the firewall mentioned in [V2G20-1013] follows the rules specified in Table 3.
This invariant ensures that all messages comply with the firewall rules defined in Table 3.
This guard ensures the EVCC has received the correct response.
This guard checks the state of EVSEProcessing.
The EVCC sends an AC_ChargeLoopReq message.
The EVCC must send the message within the specified timeout.

V2G20-1016.text: [V2G20-1016] The TimeAnchor of a PowerScheduleType element shall define the point in time when the first PowerScheduleEntry element starts to be active.

atoms.notes: Ensures that the TimeAnchor is not in the past.
Ensures that the TimeAnchor aligns with the start time of the first PowerScheduleEntry.

atoms.expr: forall PowerScheduleEntry i in PowerScheduleType: start_time_of_PowerScheduleEntry[i] >= TimeAnchor
atoms.notes: Ensures that all subsequent PowerScheduleEntries start at or after the TimeAnchor.

V2G20-1017.text: [V2G20-1017] A V2G entity shall fulfil the IPv6 node requirements specified in IETF RFC 8504.

atoms.notes: This atom represents the assumption that both the EVCC and SECC comply with the IPv6 node requirements specified in IETF RFC 8504.

V2G20-1020.text: [V2G20-1020] The XML schema with the namespace "urn:iso:std:iso:15118:-20:CommonMessages" shall be used for encoding and decoding EXI streams sent or received with Part20MainstreamPayloadID and defined in 8.3.4.1.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the correct XML schema namespace is used for encoding and decoding EXI streams.
This atom specifies that the XML schema should be applied to the Part20MainstreamPayloadID messages.
This atom ensures that the EXI stream encoding and decoding rules are as defined in section 8.3.4.1.

V2G20-1021.text: [V2G20-1021] The validity period of the OCSP response provided by the SECC shall be limited to one week.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the OCSP response's validity period does not exceed one week.

V2G20-1022.text: [V2G20-1022] After having received the SessionSetupRes, the EVCC shall check if the SessionID included in any following response messages is the same as the one received during SessionSetupRes.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SessionID in subsequent messages matches the one from SessionSetupRes.
This invariant ensures that throughout the session, the SessionID remains consistent with the one established during SessionSetupRes.

V2G20-1027.text: [V2G20-1027] If [V2G20-1540] applies and a connection based on ISO 15118-8 has been established, the EVCC shall take care that [V2G20-1541] is fulfilled as long as no alignment failure has been reported by the SECC.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the conditions specified in [V2G20-1540] apply and if the connection type is based on ISO 15118-8.
The EVCC must ensure that the requirements specified in [V2G20-1541] are met.
This guard ensures that no alignment failure has been reported by the SECC.
The EVCC must continuously fulfill [V2G20-1541] as long as no alignment failure is reported by the SECC during the session.

V2G20-1028.text: [V2G20-4000] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, the following requirements are not applicable: [V2G20-1540], [V2G20-2301], [V2G20-2624] and [V2G20-1028].

atoms.notes: This guard specifies the condition under which certain requirements are not applicable.
This invariant ensures that if the EVCC is using DC_ACDP service, the specified requirements are not applicable.

V2G20-1032.text: NOTE 2 To enable pause when using ServiceName = DC_ACDP the common requirements [V2G20-1058], [V2G20-1613], [V2G20-2545], [V2G20-1614], [V2G20-2623], [V2G20-1847], [V2G20-1061] and [V2G20-1032] apply.

atoms.notes: These common requirements must be applied in sequence to enable pause functionality when using DC_ACDP service.

V2G20-1034.text: [V2G20-1034] For all applications a positive value for elements with the physical unit "W", "Wh" and "A" shall represent a power transfer from the EVSE to the EV (charging mode).

atoms.expr: For all elements with physical_unit in ['W', 'Wh', 'A'], if value > 0 then power_transfer_direction == 'EVSE_to_EV'
atoms.notes: This constraint applies globally to ensure consistency in the interpretation of power-related values.

V2G20-1035.text: [V2G20-1035] Negative values shall be used to define energy transfer from the EV to the EVSE (discharging mode).

atoms.notes: This constraint applies globally whenever discharging mode is active.

V2G20-1039.text: [V2G20-1039] If an EVCC supports the service AC and intends to offer it for this V2G communication session, it shall add an AppProtocol element to the supportedAppProtocolReq with ProtocolNamespace set to "urn:iso:std:iso:15118:-20:AC", VersionNumberMajor set to "1" and VersionNumberMinor set to "0".

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC supports AC service and intends to offer it for the current session.
The EVCC shall add an AppProtocol element to the SupportedAppProtocolReq message.
The ProtocolNamespace field of the AppProtocol element must be set to 'urn:iso:std:iso:15118:-20:AC'.
The VersionNumberMajor field of the AppProtocol element must be set to '1'.
The VersionNumberMinor field of the AppProtocol element must be set to '0'.

V2G20-1040.text: [V2G20-1040] The conditions defined for the CP state and PWM within the message sequence requirements shall only apply to the main stream EXI encoded messages with V2GTP payload types in the range 0x8001 up to 0x80FF.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the specified conditions for CP state and PWM apply only when the V2GTP payload type is within the given range.
Ensures that the messages are EXI encoded as required by the standard.
Conditional field constraint ensuring that CP state applicability is considered when the payload type is within the specified range.
Conditional field constraint ensuring that PWM applicability is considered when the payload type is within the specified range.

V2G20-1041.text: [V2G20-1041] The timeout of the messages in the side stream shall be independent of the timeout of the messages in the main stream.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the timeout for messages in the side stream is not dependent on the timeout for messages in the main stream.
This invariant ensures that both side stream and main stream timeouts are positive values, indicating they are properly defined and independent.

V2G20-1042.text: [V2G20-1042] All timeout requirements that apply for the main stream shall be accordingly applied for the side stream messages.

atoms.expr: forall m in SideStreamMessages, exists t in MainStreamTimeouts such that m.timeout == t
atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that any timeout defined for the main stream also applies to the corresponding side stream messages.
Assumes that all side stream messages are part of the set of all possible messages in the ISO 15118-20 protocol.
Ensures that each side stream message has its timeout derived from the corresponding main stream message's timeout.

V2G20-1043.text: [V2G20-1043] If SessionStopRes with ResponseCode set to "OK" is encountered, then all communication shall terminate.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the ResponseCode in the SessionStopRes message is set to 'OK'.
This action specifies that all communication shall terminate when the guard condition is met.

V2G20-1045.text: [V2G20-1045] For all schedule renegotiation related messages, V2GTP payload type ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID shall be applied.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that for all messages related to schedule renegotiation, the correct V2GTP payload type is used.

V2G20-1046.text: [V2G20-1046] The EVCC shall use the message ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq on V2GTP payload type ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID as the first message of a schedule renegotiation message flow.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends the ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message.
The ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message is the first message in the schedule renegotiation message flow.

V2G20-1047.text: [V2G20-1047] The SECC shall respond to the ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq with ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes on V2GTP payload type ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID V2G messages.

atoms.expr: SECC sends ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes in response to ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq
atoms.notes: This action specifies the SECC's responsibility to send a ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message.
This constraint ensures that the V2GTP payload type is correctly set for the ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message.
This constraint defines the sequence in which messages should be exchanged between the EVCC and SECC.

V2G20-1048.text: [V2G20-1048] After receiving the ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes, the EVCC shall send a ScheduleExchangeReq on V2GTP payload type ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the EVCC has received the ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message before proceeding.
The EVCC is required to send a ScheduleExchangeReq with the specified V2GTP payload type after receiving the ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes.
This ensures the correct sequence of messages, where ScheduleExchangeReq follows ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes.

V2G20-1049.text: [V2G20-1049] To exit the schedule renegotiation process, the SECC shall send a PowerDeliveryRes on V2GTP payload type ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID with ResponseCode = OK.

atoms.expr: send(PowerDeliveryRes) where PayloadType = ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID and ResponseCode = OK
atoms.notes: This action describes the SECC's responsibility to send a specific response to exit the schedule renegotiation process.
This guard ensures that the payload type is correctly set for the schedule renegotiation process.
This field constraint specifies that the ResponseCode must be set to OK when exiting the schedule renegotiation process.

V2G20-1050.text: [V2G20-1050] The new EVPowerProfile as a result from the schedule renegotiation session shall be applied in the next ChargeLoopReq on the mainstream communication channel.

atoms.expr: EVPowerProfile shall be included in the next ChargeLoopReq
atoms.notes: This action specifies that the new EVPowerProfile resulting from the schedule renegotiation session should be sent in the next ChargeLoopReq.

atoms.expr: ChargeLoopReq with new EVPowerProfile shall follow the renegotiation session
atoms.notes: This sequence constraint ensures that the ChargeLoopReq containing the new EVPowerProfile is sent after the renegotiation session has completed.
This guard ensures that the schedule renegotiation session has been completed before applying the new EVPowerProfile.

V2G20-1051.text: [V2G20-1051] During schedule renegotiation according to [V2G20-1045] the EVCC shall maintain the charging behavior based on [V2G20-1825].

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the schedule renegotiation process is active.
The EVCC maintains its charging behavior as specified by V2G20-1825 during the renegotiation.
The charging behavior must remain consistent with what is defined in V2G20-1825 throughout the session.
It is assumed that the renegotiation rules specified in V2G20-1045 are being followed.

V2G20-1052.text: [V2G20-1052] When the EVCC received a message where the EVSENotification is set to ScheduleRenegotiation, it shall send a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq within the number of seconds provided in NotificationMaxDelay with updated parameters based on the current situation on V2GTP payload type ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVSENotification field is set to ScheduleRenegotiation.
The EVCC shall send a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq with updated parameters.
The ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq must be sent within the time specified by NotificationMaxDelay.
The V2GTP payload type should be ScheduleRenegotiationPayloadID for the updated parameters.

V2G20-1053.text: [V2G20-1053] Requirements [V2G20-1047], [V2G20-1048], [V2G20-1049] and [V2G20-1050] shall apply as subsequent steps.

atoms.expr: [V2G20-1047], [V2G20-1048], [V2G20-1049], [V2G20-1050] shall be applied sequentially after this step
atoms.notes: This atom indicates that the specified requirements must be followed in order as subsequent steps.

V2G20-1054.text: [V2G20-1054] For all messages related to parking assistance service, V2GTP payload type ParkingStatusPayloadID shall be applied.

applies_to_messages: all messages related to parking assistance service
atoms.notes: This atom ensures that for any message concerning the parking assistance service, the correct payload type is used.

V2G20-1056.text: [V2G20-1056] The value MaximumSupportPoints shall not exceed 1024.

atoms.notes: This constraint applies globally to ensure the MaximumSupportPoints does not exceed the specified limit.

V2G20-1058.text: NOTE 2 To enable pause when using ServiceName = DC_ACDP the common requirements [V2G20-1058], [V2G20-1613], [V2G20-2545], [V2G20-1614], [V2G20-2623], [V2G20-1847], [V2G20-1061] and [V2G20-1032] apply.

atoms.notes: This sequence constraint indicates the order in which the common requirements must be applied when using ServiceName = DC_ACDP.
This assumption states that the pause functionality is enabled when using ServiceName = DC_ACDP.

V2G20-1059.text: [V2G20-1059] The EVCC and SECC shall cache the relevant authorization data for the duration of the V2G communication session.

atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that both EVCC and SECC maintain cached authorization data throughout the session.
This guard ensures that caching is only relevant when a V2G communication session is active.

V2G20-1061.text: [V2G20-1061] In scheduled control mode, any pause period initiated by the SECC shall be indicated as zero power period in the currently applied EVPowerProfile, sent in the latest PowerDeliveryReq with Charge progress set to "Start", "Standby", "Stop" or "Pause".

atoms.notes: Ensures the requirement only applies in scheduled control mode.
Ensures the charge progress is one of the specified values.
Indicates that the pause period should be marked as a zero power period.
Ensures the latest PowerDeliveryReq has one of the specified ChargeProgress values.
Ensures EVPowerProfile is mandatory in the PowerDeliveryReq.

V2G20-1063.text: [V2G20-1063] In case of PnC, the EVCC shall sign the PnC_AReqAuthorizationMode element using the private key associated with the contract certificate.

atoms.notes: This action specifies that the EVCC must sign the PnC_AReqAuthorizationMode element using the private key linked to its contract certificate.
This guard ensures that the action only applies when the PnC mode is active.
This field constraint ensures that the PnC_AReqAuthorizationMode element is of type 'Signature'.

V2G20-1065.text: [V2G20-1065] If the BPT service was selected in either AC or DC and the reverse power transfer system requires HLC-based control of switching electricity power channels, the parameter BPT_ChannelSelection of PowerDeliveryReq shall be applied.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the BPT service was selected and if the reverse power transfer system requires HLC-based control.
This action specifies that the BPT_ChannelSelection parameter should be included in the PowerDeliveryReq message.
This field constraint ensures that BPT_ChannelSelection is a mandatory field in the PowerDeliveryReq message when the conditions are met.
Precondition for sending AC_ChargeLoopReq
EVCC sends AC_ChargeLoopReq message
SECC responds with AC_ChargeLoopRes message
SECC must respond within specified timeout
Ordering constraint between messages
This guard checks if the received SVCStatus meets specific criteria.
The EVCC sends a ServiceDetailRes message in response.
Ensures the ServiceParameterList contains at least one parameter.
This guard checks the conditions under which the EVCC should proceed.
Field constraints for the AC_ChargeLoopReq message.
Ensures the correct sequence of messages.
Ensures the service category is correctly set for energy transfer.
The EVCC shall send the SVCDiscoveryRes message.
The ServiceID field must be present in the message.
The ServiceCategory field may or may not be included.
The SVCDiscoveryRes message must follow the SVCDiscoveryReq message within the session.
The message must be sent within the specified timeout period.
The ServiceCategory should never be set to 'Unknown'.

atoms.expr: SECC is ready to receive SVCDiscoveryRes
atoms.notes: It is assumed that the SECC is in a state where it can accept the SVCDiscoveryRes message.

V2G20-1070.text: [V2G20-1070] The SECC shall always accept the EVPowerProfile of the EVCC (see 8.3.5.3.9) if it does not violate the rules of requirement [V2G20-1559].

atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that the SECC always accepts the EVPowerProfile provided by the EVCC as long as it adheres to the constraints specified in requirement V2G20-1559.
This assumption states that the EVPowerProfile sent by the EVCC is valid according to the rules defined in requirement V2G20-1559.

V2G20-1077.text: [V2G20-1077] The certificate provisioning service shall sign the SignedInstallationData element of the CertificateInstallationRes using the private key associated with the CPS leaf certificate.

atoms.notes: This action specifies that the SECC must use the private key linked to the CPS leaf certificate to sign the SignedInstallationData element within the CertificateInstallationRes message.
Ensures that the signature algorithm used for signing the SignedInstallationData matches the algorithm specified in the CPS leaf certificate.
Assumes that the CPS leaf certificate's private key exists and is accessible by the SECC for signing operations.

V2G20-1078.text: [V2G20-1078] The EVCC shall verify the signature of the CertificateInstallationRes Message using the signer certificate chain CPSCertificateChain, validate said chain according to [V2G20-1001], [V2G20-2324] and [V2G20-2325] while leaving out the revocation check, and ensure that it traces back to a trusted root certificate.

atoms.notes: The EVCC must perform signature verification on the CertificateInstallationRes message.
The EVCC must validate the certificate chain according to specific rules but excluding revocation checks.
The EVCC must ensure that the certificate chain traces back to a trusted root certificate.
It is assumed that the EVCC has access to a list of trusted root certificates for validation.

V2G20-1081.text: [V2G20-1081] If the EVCC wants to receive the MeterInfo element, the EVCC shall set the parameter MeterInfoRequested to TRUE in the ChargeLoopReq, depending on the charging services on V2GTP payload type EXI encoded V2G messages.

atoms.notes: This is an abstract guard representing the EVCC's desire to receive MeterInfo.
The EVCC sets MeterInfoRequested to TRUE when it wants to receive MeterInfo.
MeterInfoRequested is an optional field in ChargeLoopReq.
MeterInfoRequested is a boolean field.

atoms.expr: Charging services use V2GTP payload type EXI encoded V2G messages
atoms.notes: Assumption about the encoding and transport layer used for V2G messages.

V2G20-1082.text: [V2G20-1082] If [V2G20-1081] applies, the SECC shall respond with the ChargeLoopRes including the MeterInfo element.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the condition specified in V2G20-1081 is met.
The SECC is required to send a ChargeLoopRes message containing the MeterInfo element.
Ensures that the MeterInfo element is included and marked as mandatory within the ChargeLoopRes message.

V2G20-1083.text: [V2G20-1083] If the SECC wants to trigger a MeteringConfirmationReq/Res, the SECC shall include the MeterInfo in its ChargeLoopRes and set the EVSENotification to MeteringConfirmation.

atoms.notes: This guard represents the condition where the SECC decides to trigger a MeteringConfirmationReq/Res.
The SECC includes the MeterInfo in the ChargeLoopRes and sets the EVSENotification to MeteringConfirmation.

V2G20-1084.text: [V2G20-1084] If [V2G20-1083] applies, the EVCC shall send a MeteringConfirmationReq on V2GTP payload type MeteringConfirmationPayloadID.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the previous requirement V2G20-1083 is applicable.
The EVCC sends a MeteringConfirmationReq with the specified V2GTP payload type.

V2G20-1085.text: [V2G20-1085] If [V2G20-1084] applies, the SECC shall respond with a MeteringConfirmationRes on V2GTP payload type MeteringConfirmationPayloadID.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the condition specified in V2G20-1084 is met.
The SECC is required to send a MeteringConfirmationRes with the specified V2GTP payload type.

V2G20-1089.text: [V2G20-1089] The SECC shall not send ResponseCode set to OK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation in supportedAppProtocolRes, since deviations are not supported by ISO 15118-20 (this document).

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC does not send a ResponseCode indicating minor deviations, which are not supported in ISO 15118-20.

V2G20-1090.text: [V2G20-1090] In case the EVCC receives a supportedAppProtocolRes with ResponseCode set to OK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation, the EVCC shall treat it the same as when the SECC would have sent OK_SuccessfulNegotiation.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received ResponseCode is OK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation.
The EVCC shall treat the received supportedAppProtocolRes with ResponseCode OK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation the same as OK_SuccessfulNegotiation.

This invariant ensures that throughout the session, if the EVCC receives a supportedAppProtocolRes with ResponseCode OK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation, it treats it as OK_SuccessfulNegotiation.

V2G20-1138.text: [V2G20-1138] ISO 15118 enabled EVCC shall confirm to IEC 61851-1 in case of charging.

atoms.notes: This assumption ensures that the EVCC adheres to the IEC 61851-1 standard during charging operations.

V2G20-1194.text: [V2G20-1194] To enter a standby period, the EVCC shall stop charging (no current drawn by EV) before sending a PowerDeliveryReq message with ChargeProgress set to "Standby".

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that no current is being drawn by the EV before proceeding.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq message with ChargeProgress set to 'Standby'.
This constraint ensures that stopping charging precedes sending the PowerDeliveryReq message.

V2G20-1195.text: [V2G20-1195] The message "SessionStopRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "FAILED_PauseNotAllowed" if the EVCC requests a pause in dynamic control mode, which has not been initiated by the SECC according to [V2G20-1850].

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC requests a pause in dynamic control mode.
Ensures that the pause was not initiated by the SECC.
Specifies the response code when the conditions are met.

atoms.expr: ResponseCode is mandatory and of type Enum
atoms.notes: Ensures the ResponseCode field is properly defined.

atoms.expr: SessionStopReq followed by SessionStopRes with ResponseCode == FAILED_PauseNotAllowed
atoms.notes: Ensures the correct sequence of messages and response.

V2G20-1196.text: [V2G20-1196] The message "SessionStopRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "FAILED_PauseNotAllowed" if the EVCC requests a pause in scheduled control mode that is not indicated by a 0kW period in the currently applied EVPowerProfileEntry.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC requests a pause that is not indicated by a 0kW period.
This action specifies that the SECC shall send a SessionStopRes with ResponseCode 'FAILED_PauseNotAllowed'.

atoms.expr: SessionStopRes.ResponseCode is mandatory and of type Enum
atoms.notes: This ensures that the ResponseCode field is correctly defined in the SessionStopRes message.

V2G20-1197.text: [V2G20-1197] At the point in time when entering pause by SessionStopReq with ChargingSession=Pause in Scheduled control mode, the EVCC shall ensure that the applied EVPowerProfileEntry is equal to 0kW.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the correct conditions for entering pause mode.
The EVCC must set the power profile entry to 0kW when pausing.
This invariant ensures that the power profile remains at 0kW during the paused state.

V2G20-1198.text: [V2G20-1198] At the point in time when requesting pause by setting the parameter EVSENotification to Pause in scheduled control mode, the SECC shall ensure that the applied EVPowerProfileEntry is equal to 0kW.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the conditions under which the action should be taken.
The SECC sets the AppliedEVPowerProfileEntry to 0kW when the guard conditions are met.

atoms.expr: if EVSENotification == Pause AND ControlMode == Scheduled then AppliedEVPowerProfileEntry == 0kW
atoms.notes: Ensures that whenever the SECC requests a pause in scheduled control mode, the power profile entry is zeroed out.

V2G20-1199.text: [V2G20-1199] In scheduled control mode, the EVCC shall ensure it is resuming the communication session according to [V2G20-1541], while the applied EVPowerProfileEntry is still equal to 0 kW.

atoms.notes: The EVCC shall resume the communication session according to [V2G20-1541].
Ensures the applied EVPowerProfileEntry is still equal to 0 kW.
Specifies the next allowed request in the sequence is to resume the communication session.

V2G20-1200.text: [V2G20-1200] In case of EIM, the SECC shall send AuthorizationRes with ResponseCode = "OK" and EVSEProcessing = "Finished" once the external authorization has been successfully completed.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC only sends the response when EIM is used and external authorization is complete.

atoms.expr: send AuthorizationRes with ResponseCode = 'OK' AND EVSEProcessing = 'Finished'
atoms.notes: The SECC must send an AuthorizationRes message with specific values for ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing fields.
Ensures that the ResponseCode field is present and has the correct value.
Ensures that the EVSEProcessing field is present and has the correct value.

V2G20-1201.text: [V2G20-1201] If more than one ScheduleTuple containing PriceLevelSchedule is sent to the EV, they shall have the same NumberOfPriceLevels and priceLevels inside.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if there are multiple ScheduleTuples with PriceLevelSchedule.

atoms.expr: forall ScheduleTuple_i, ScheduleTuple_j where i != j: ScheduleTuple_i.NumberOfPriceLevels == ScheduleTuple_j.NumberOfPriceLevels
atoms.notes: Ensures all ScheduleTuples have the same NumberOfPriceLevels.

atoms.expr: forall ScheduleTuple_i, ScheduleTuple_j where i != j: ScheduleTuple_i.priceLevels == ScheduleTuple_j.priceLevels
atoms.notes: Ensures all ScheduleTuples have the same priceLevels.

atoms.expr: forall ScheduleTuple: if ScheduleTuple contains PriceLevelSchedule then NumberOfPriceLevels > 0
atoms.notes: Ensures that if a ScheduleTuple contains PriceLevelSchedule, NumberOfPriceLevels is greater than zero.

V2G20-1202.text: [V2G20-1202] An EVCC and an SECC shall support minimum 12 entries for PowerScheduleEntry, PriceRule and priceLevelScheduleEntries elements inside one ScheduleTuple.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that both the EVCC and SECC support at least 12 entries for each specified element within a ScheduleTuple.

V2G20-1204.text: [V2G20-1204] For all message elements of type RationalNumberType the SECC and the EVCC shall apply the value range and unit definition as according to Table 94.

atoms.expr: forall m in messages where m contains RationalNumberType: m.RationalNumberType.value within Table94.valueRange AND m.RationalNumberType.unit == Table94.unit
atoms.notes: This atom ensures that any message element of type RationalNumberType adheres to the specified value range and unit as defined in Table 94.

V2G20-1207.text: [V2G20-1207] The EVCC and the SECC shall implement the message elements as defined in Table 59 and Figure 63.

atoms.expr: MessageElement.type = DefinedType AND MessageElement.mandatory = DefinedMandatoryStatus AND MessageElement.domain = DefinedDomain
atoms.notes: This atom ensures that all message elements implemented by both EVCC and SECC adhere to the specifications provided in Table 59 and Figure 63.

V2G20-1209.text: [V2G20-1209] SECC shall not send _L2, _L3 values in any messages (ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes, AC_ChargeLoopRes) if it neither received _L2 nor _L3 values in ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC has not received L2 or L3 values in the ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq.
Ensures that L2 and L3 fields are not present in ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes if they were not received in ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq.
Ensures that L2 and L3 fields are not present in AC_ChargeLoopRes if they were not received in ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq.

V2G20-1210.text: [V2G20-1210] If the charging session is subject to metering and an AbsolutePriceSchedule with power specific pricing rules has been selected, then the SECC shall provide the EVSEPresentActivePower[_L2,_L3] measurements during the charging process.

atoms.notes: Checks if the charging session conditions for metering and price schedule type are met.
The SECC must send the EVSEPresentActivePower measurements for L2 and L3 phases during the charging process.
Ensures that the EVSEPresentActivePower fields for L2 and L3 are of type float.
Ensures that the EVSEPresentActivePower fields for L2 and L3 are mandatory when sent.

atoms.expr: if ChargingSessionSubjectToMetering && SelectedPriceScheduleType == 'AbsolutePriceSchedule' && PriceRuleType == 'PowerSpecific' then EVSEPresentActivePower_L2 != null && EVSEPresentActivePower_L3 != null
atoms.notes: Ensures that EVSEPresentActivePower measurements for L2 and L3 are not null when the specified conditions are met.

V2G20-1213.text: [V2G20-1213] Parameters used for discharging the EV battery shall be set with a negative value, parameters used for charging shall be set with positive value.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that when the EV is discharging, the PMax parameter is set to a non-positive value.
This atom ensures that when the EV is charging, the PMax parameter is set to a positive value.

V2G20-1214.text: [V2G20-1214] In case dynamic control mode was selected, unless otherwise stated, anytime an element is prefixed with dynamic (e.g.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the dynamic control mode has been selected.
This field constraint applies to any field that should be prefixed with 'dynamic' when in dynamic control mode.
This invariant ensures that all relevant fields are prefixed with 'dynamic' throughout the session if dynamic control mode is active.
This assumption clarifies that the dynamic prefixing only applies unless there is a specific exception stated elsewhere in the specification.

V2G20-1215.text: [V2G20-1215] In case scheduled control mode was selected, unless otherwise stated, anytime an element is prefixed with Scheduled (e.g.

atoms.expr: if ControlMode == Scheduled then prefix elements with 'Scheduled'
atoms.notes: This field constraint specifies that any element should be prefixed with 'Scheduled' when the scheduled control mode is active.

V2G20-1346.text: [V2G20-1346] The EVSE shall calculate the Power values in the ScheduleTuple based on the parameter EVSENominalVoltage.

atoms.notes: The SECC is responsible for calculating the Power values within the ScheduleTuple based on the EVSENominalVoltage.
Ensures that EVSENominalVoltage is present and of the correct type before calculation.
Ensures all Power values in ScheduleTuple are of the correct type after calculation.

V2G20-1347.text: [V2G20-1347] The EVCC shall use the value EVSENominalVoltage provided by the SECC to calculate the maximum available charging current based on the Power values provided in the PowerSchedule of the ScheduleExchangeRes and the Power values in the element EVPowerProfile of the PowerDeliveryReq message.

atoms.notes: The EVSENominalVoltage must be provided by the SECC.
The PowerSchedule must be provided by the SECC.
The EVPowerProfile must be provided by the EVCC.
The EVCC shall perform the calculation for the maximum available charging current.
The calculated maximum charging current should be non-negative.

This action specifies that the SECC should send an AC_ChargeLoopRes message with ResponseCode set to OK.

atoms.expr: ResponseCode is mandatory and its type is Enumerated
atoms.notes: Ensures that the ResponseCode field is mandatory and of the correct type in the AC_ChargeLoopRes message.
This guard checks if the ResponseCode in SessionSetupRes is Accepted.
This timing constraint specifies the deadline for sending SessionStopReq.
The SessionStopReason field in SessionStopReq must be set to EndCommunication.

V2G20-1367.text: [V2G20-1367] If the EVCC selected the service parameter "MobilityNeedsMode" set to 2 and the SECC received new values for departure time, target SOC or minimum SOC from a secondary actor, the SECC shall include those updated values in DepartureTime, TargetSOC or MinimumSOC, respectively.

atoms.expr: if new_departure_time_received then set DepartureTime to new_departure_time
atoms.notes: The SECC includes the updated departure time in the response if a new value was received.

atoms.expr: if new_target_soc_received then set TargetSOC to new_target_soc
atoms.notes: The SECC includes the updated target SOC in the response if a new value was received.

atoms.expr: if new_minimum_soc_received then set MinimumSOC to new_minimum_soc
atoms.notes: The SECC includes the updated minimum SOC in the response if a new value was received.

V2G20-1368.text: [V2G20-1368] If the EVCC selected the service parameter MobilityNeedsMode set to 2 and receives a AC_ChargeLoopRes message with DepartureTime, TargetSOC or MinimumSOC, and if the EVCC accepts this DepartureTime, TargetSOC or MinimumSOC, then the EVCC shall send updated values in a AC_ChargeLoopReq within the number of seconds stated in AckMaxDelay of AC_ChargeLoopRes.

V2G20-1369.text: [V2G20-1369] If the EVCC selected the service parameter MobilityNeedsMode set to 2 and EVCC receives a AC_ChargeLoopRes message with DepartureTime, TargetSOC or MinimumSOC, and if the EVCC cannot accept this DepartureTime, TargetSOC or MinimumSOC, e.g.

atoms.expr: AC_ChargeLoopRes.DepartureTime != null || AC_ChargeLoopRes.TargetSOC != null || AC_ChargeLoopRes.MinimumSOC != null
atoms.notes: Checks if the AC_ChargeLoopRes message contains DepartureTime, TargetSOC, or MinimumSOC fields.
Evaluates whether the EVCC can accept the provided DepartureTime, TargetSOC, or MinimumSOC values.
The EVCC sends an AC_ChargeLoopReq message with ResponseCode set to 'Rejected' if it cannot accept the parameters.

V2G20-1380.text: [V2G20-1380] When the EVCC wants to enter a standby period, after having received DC_PreChargeRes with ResponseCode equal to "OK" and if the EVCC determines that the EVSE output voltage, as measured inside the EV, has sufficiently been adjusted to the EV RESS voltage, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress equal to "Standby, while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: Checks if the ResponseCode in DC_PreChargeRes is 'OK'.
Assumes a function EVSEVoltageAdjustedToRESSVoltage that checks if the EVSE output voltage is sufficiently adjusted to the EV RESS voltage.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Standby'.
Ensures that the V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is within the allowed performance time before sending PowerDeliveryReq.

V2G20-1381.text: [V2G20-1381] When the EVCC wants to enter a standby period, after having received DC_ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress equal to "Standby", while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC has received the DC_ChargeLoopRes message.
Ensures the V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is within the performance time limit.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Standby'.
Ensures the ChargeProgress field in PowerDeliveryReq is set to 'Standby'.

V2G20-1383.text: [V2G20-1383] When the EVCC wants to exit a standby period, after having received DC_ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC wants to exit the standby period and has received DC_ChargeLoopRes.
Ensures the transition occurs within the specified performance time.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq when exiting the standby period.

V2G20-1385.text: [V2G20-1385] The SECC shall enter standby, after having received PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to "Standby", by sending a PowerDeliveryRes with ResponseCode is set to "OK" while V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timeout.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC has received a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to Standby.
The SECC sends a PowerDeliveryRes with ResponseCode set to OK.
The action must be completed within the specified timeout period.
After sending the PowerDeliveryRes, the SECC enters the Standby state.

V2G20-1386.text: [V2G20-1386] The SECC shall exit standby, after having received PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to "Start", "Stop", or "Renegotiate", by sending a PowerDeliveryRes with ResponseCode set to "OK", while V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timeout.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the SECC has received a PowerDeliveryReq with the specified ChargeProgress values.

V2G20-1390.text: [V2G20-1390] When the EVCC wants to enter a standby period, after having received the ScheduleExchangeRes with parameter "EVSEProcessing" set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress set to "Standby",

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to Standby to initiate the standby period.
This ensures that the PowerDeliveryReq follows the ScheduleExchangeRes in the message sequence.

V2G20-1391.text: [V2G20-1391] When the EVCC wants to enter a standby period, after having received ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress set to "Standby", while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the EVCC has received a ChargeLoopRes before proceeding.

V2G20-1393.text: [V2G20-1393] When the EVCC wants to exit a standby period, after having received ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress set to "Start", "Stop", or "Renegotiate", while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC has the intention to exit a standby period and has already received a ChargeLoopRes.

atoms.expr: send(PowerDeliveryReq, ChargeProgress = 'Start' OR ChargeProgress = 'Stop' OR ChargeProgress = 'Renegotiate')
atoms.notes: The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to either 'Start', 'Stop', or 'Renegotiate'.

V2G20-1394.text: [V2G20-1394] When the EVCC wants to enter a standby period, after having received MeteringConfirmationRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress set to "Standby", while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the EVCC has received the MeteringConfirmationRes before proceeding.
This guard ensures that the EVCC's sequence timer is within the performance time limit.
This action specifies that the EVCC should send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Standby'.
This field constraint ensures that the ChargeProgress field in PowerDeliveryReq is set to 'Standby'.

V2G20-1395.text: [V2G20-1395] When the EVCC wants to exit a standby period, after having received MeteringConfirmationRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress set to "Start", "Stop", or "Renegotiate", while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC wants to exit a standby period and has received a MeteringConfirmationRes.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Start', 'Stop', or 'Renegotiate'.

V2G20-1396.text: [V2G20-1396] After receiving the message "PowerDeliveryRes" with ResponseCode equal to "WARNING_StandbyNotAllowed", the EVCC shall ignore all other parameters of the response message and shall do one (1) of the following.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the ResponseCode in PowerDeliveryRes is WARNING_StandbyNotAllowed.
The EVCC shall ignore all other parameters of the PowerDeliveryRes message when the ResponseCode is WARNING_StandbyNotAllowed.
After ignoring other parameters, the EVCC shall choose one of the specified actions, though the specific actions are not detailed in the given requirement text.

V2G20-1397.text: [V2G20-1397] The EVCC shall wait for the cable check of the EVSE to finish indicated by the reception of a DC_CableCheckRes with ResponseCode equal to "OK" and EVSEProcessing equal to "Finished".

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the EVCC waits for the correct response indicating the cable check has finished.
The EVCC should receive the DC_CableCheckRes within the specified timeout period.
The next expected message after initiating the cable check process is DC_CableCheckRes.

V2G20-1398.text: [V2G20-1398] The EVCC shall stop waiting for the Cable check of the EVSE to finish and stop monitoring the V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timer when V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timer is equal or larger than V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timeout.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the cable check timer has exceeded its timeout.
The EVCC stops waiting for the cable check to finish once the timeout is reached.
The EVCC stops monitoring the cable check timer after the timeout.

V2G20-1399.text: [V2G20-1399] The EVCC shall stop waiting for the cable check of the EVSE to finish and stop monitoring the V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timer if V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timeout and a DC_CableCheckRes message with ResponseCode equal to "OK" and EVSEProcessing equal to "Finished" was received.

atoms.notes: Checks if the cable check timer is within the timeout limit.
Ensures the received DC_CableCheckRes message has the correct ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing values.
The EVCC stops monitoring the V2G_EVCC_DC_CableCheck_Timer.

V2G20-1400.text: [V2G20-1400] The EVCC shall wait for the pre charging to finish, indicated by the EV determining that the EVSE output voltage, as measured inside the EV, has sufficiently been adjusted to the EV RESS voltage.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVSE output voltage has been adjusted to the target voltage of the EV's RESS.
The EVCC must complete the pre-charging phase within the specified timeout.
The EVCC should wait until the pre-charging process is completed.
The EVSE output voltage must remain within the acceptable range during the pre-charging phase.
It is assumed that the SECC can adjust the output voltage to match the EV's requirements.

V2G20-1401.text: [V2G20-1401] The EVCC shall stop monitoring the V2G_EVCC_DC_PreCharge_Timer when V2G_EVCC_DC_PreCharge_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_DC_PreCharge_Timeout and pre charging has finished, indicated by the EV determining that the EVSE output voltage, as measured inside the EV, has sufficiently been adjusted to the EV RESS voltage.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the timer is still within the allowed timeout.
This guard checks if the EVSE output voltage has been adjusted to the EV RESS voltage.
The EVCC stops monitoring the precharge timer once the conditions are met.

V2G20-1402.text: [V2G20-1945] The message PowerDeliveryRes shall contain the ResponseCode "FAILED_PowerToleranceNotConfirmed" if the EVCC has sent a PowerDeliveryReq containing the parameter PowerToleranceAcceptance with the value set to "PowerToleranceNotConfirmed" and based on this the SECC intends to stop the V2G communication session, according to [V2G20-1402].

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC has sent a PowerDeliveryReq with PowerToleranceAcceptance set to 'PowerToleranceNotConfirmed'.
Ensures that the SECC intends to stop the V2G communication session.
The SECC shall send a PowerDeliveryRes with ResponseCode set to 'FAILED_PowerToleranceNotConfirmed'.
Ensures the correct sequence of messages from PowerDeliveryReq to PowerDeliveryRes.

V2G20-1404.text: [V2G20-1404] ISO 15118-enabled EVSE shall conform to IEC 61851-1.

atoms.notes: This atom represents the assumption that the SECC conforms to IEC 61851-1 as required by V2G20-1404.

V2G20-1408.text: [V2G20-1408] The SECC shall apply a CP duty cycle of 5% from start of data link setup until end of V2G communication session.

atoms.notes: The SECC applies a specific CP duty cycle throughout the session.
The specified CP duty cycle is applied from the beginning of data link setup until the end of the V2G communication session.
The CP duty cycle must remain at 5% for the duration of the session.

V2G20-1409.text: [V2G20-1409] ISO 15118 enabled SECC shall confirm to IEC 61851-1 in case of charging.

V2G20-1411.text: [V2G20-1411] The message "PowerDeliveryRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "FAILED_PowerDeliveryNotApplied" if the EVSE is not able to deliver energy.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVSE is not able to deliver energy by ensuring isolation status is not isolated and processing state is not applicable.
This action specifies that the SECC shall set the ResponseCode to 'FAILED_PowerDeliveryNotApplied' when the guard condition is met.
Ensures that the ResponseCode field is mandatory in the PowerDeliveryRes message.

V2G20-1412.text: [V2G20-2223] After receiving the CertificateInstallationReq, if an issue was detected with the provided OEM provisioning certificate chain, the SECC shall respond with a CertificateInstallationRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" and ResponseCode starting with "WARNING", specifying the detected issue with the provided OEMProvisioningCertificate chain (refer to [V2G20-2203], [V2G20-1412], [V2G20-2204] and [V2G20-2205] for further details of the ResponseCode to be provided) within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC has received the CertificateInstallationReq and detected an issue with the OEM provisioning certificate chain.
The SECC sends a CertificateInstallationRes with specific values for EVSEProcessing and ResponseCode.
The ResponseCode should specify the detected issue with the OEMProvisioningCertificateChain.
The response must be sent within the specified timeout period.
Assumes that the ResponseCode values are defined and valid according to the referenced requirements.

V2G20-1413.text: [V2G20-1413] If the EVCC sends a valid parameter EVPowerProfile (as defined in [V2G20-1070]) in the message PowerDeliveryReq the SECC shall ensure that the power envelope defined by the PowerSchedule in the ChargingSchedule as well as, if present, the DischargingSchedule, can be utilized for the entire time span which they cover.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the EVPowerProfile sent by the EVCC is valid.

atoms.expr: SECC checks the power envelope defined by PowerSchedule and DischargingSchedule if present
atoms.notes: The SECC must verify the power envelope against the provided schedules.

atoms.expr: PowerSchedule and DischargingSchedule (if present) cover the entire time span of EVPowerProfile
atoms.notes: Ensures that the schedules cover the required time span.

atoms.expr: PowerSchedule and DischargingSchedule (if present) can be utilized for their entire time span
atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that the schedules can be used throughout their duration.

V2G20-1414.text: [V2G20-1414] If the EVCC sends PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress=Renegotiate it shall not send an EVPowerProfile.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the ChargeProgress field in PowerDeliveryReq is set to Renegotiate.
This field constraint ensures that when ChargeProgress is Renegotiate, no EVPowerProfile should be sent in PowerDeliveryReq.

V2G20-1416.text: [V2G20-1416] If the parameter EVSENotification in EVSEStatus is equal to Terminate, the EVCC shall stop charging within the number of seconds provided in NotificationMaxDelay.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVSENotification parameter in the EVSEStatus indicates termination.
The EVCC shall stop charging based on the received notification.
The EVCC must stop charging within the specified NotificationMaxDelay time.

V2G20-1431.text: [V2G20-1431] After receiving the DC_CableCheckRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send another DC_CableCheckReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 217.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends another DC_CableCheckReq after the specified conditions are met.
The EVCC must send the next DC_CableCheckReq within the specified timeout.
The next allowed request after receiving the DC_CableCheckRes under the given conditions is DC_CableCheckReq.

V2G20-1432.text: [V2G20-1432] After receiving the DC_CableCheckRes with "ResponseCode = OK", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a DC_PreChargeReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 217.

atoms.notes: Specifies the action for the EVCC after the guard conditions are met.
Ensures the correct sequence of messages between DC_CableCheckRes and DC_PreChargeReq.

V2G20-1433.text: [V2G20-1433] After receiving the DC_PreChargeRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a DC_PreChargeReq with EVProcessing set to "Ongoing" within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 217 while the precharge process is not finished.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends a DC_PreChargeReq with EVProcessing set to 'Ongoing'.
The precharge process is not considered finished during this state.

V2G20-1434.text: [V2G20-1434] After receiving the DC_PreChargeRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a DC_PreChargeReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished" within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 217 when the precharge process is finished.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the precharge process on the EV side is completed.
This action specifies what the EVCC should do after the guards are satisfied.

V2G20-1435.text: [V2G20-1435] After receiving the DC_PreChargeRes message with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: The EVCC is required to send a PowerDeliveryReq message after meeting the specified conditions.
The PowerDeliveryReq must be sent within the V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout period after receiving the DC_PreChargeRes message.
This constraint specifies the order of messages, ensuring that PowerDeliveryReq follows DC_PreChargeRes.

V2G20-1436.text: [V2G20-1436] If the EVCC is not finished calculating the EVPowerProfile, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with EVProcessing set to "Ongoing" within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC has not completed calculating the EVPowerProfile.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with EVProcessing set to 'Ongoing'.

atoms.expr: EVProcessing is mandatory and its domain is {'Ongoing', 'Finished'}
atoms.notes: Ensures that EVProcessing is properly defined in the PowerDeliveryReq.

V2G20-1534.text: [V2G20-1534] The value of the TimeStamp element of the common MessageHeaderType shall always be in SECC time and encoded at microseconds resolution.
