V2G20-4047.text: [V2G20-4047] After receiving the ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send another ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Ensures the correct sequence of messages according to the protocol.

V2G20-4048.text: [V2G20-4048] When the EV has determined that it is sufficiently well positioned to meet the requirement 201.1 of IEC 61851-23, and is immobilized, the EVCC shall send a ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq with EVMobilityStatus set to "EV is immobilized", within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EV is sufficiently well positioned and immobilized.
The EVCC sends a ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq with EVMobilityStatus set to 'EV is immobilized'.
The ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq must be sent within the specified timeout.

atoms.expr: EVMobilityStatus is mandatory and its value is 'EV is immobilized' in ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq
atoms.notes: Ensures that EVMobilityStatus is present and correctly set in the message.

V2G20-4049.text: [V2G20-4049] After receiving the ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes with "ResponseCode = OK", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send an AuthorizationSetupReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Ensures that the AuthorizationSetupReq is sent as the next message after receiving ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes.

V2G20-4050.text: [V2G20-4050] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, in Table 204, after receiving the ScheduleExchangeRes with "ResponseCode = OK", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a ACDP_ConnectReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends an ACDP_ConnectReq message.
Specifies the order of messages: ScheduleExchangeRes must precede ACDP_ConnectReq.

V2G20-4051.text: [V2G20-4051] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, after receiving the ACDP_ConnectRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send another ACDP_ConnectReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends another ACDP_ConnectReq message.

atoms.expr: next message is ACDP_ConnectReq after ACDP_ConnectRes
atoms.notes: Specifies the order of messages: ACDP_ConnectRes followed by ACDP_ConnectReq.

V2G20-4052.text: [V2G20-4052] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, after receiving the ACDP_ConnectRes with "ResponseCode = OK", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a DC_CableCheckReq if ServiceName = DC_ACDP or DC_ACDP_BPT in Table 204 was selected within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Verifies if either DC_ACDP or DC_ACDP_BPT is selected.

V2G20-4053.text: [V2G20-4053] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204, after receiving the PowerDeliveryRes as a response to a previous PowerDeliveryReq message with ChargeProgress equal to "Stop", the EVCC shall send a ACDP_DisconnectReq while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: Ensures the ACDP_DisconnectReq follows a PowerDeliveryRes.

V2G20-4054.text: [V2G20-4054] After receiving the ACDP_DisconnectRes with ResponseCode = "OK" and "EVSEProcessing = Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a ACDP_DisconnectReq while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the conditions after receiving ACDP_DisconnectRes.

V2G20-4055.text: [V2G20-4055] After receiving the ACDP_DisconnectRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and with parameter "EVSEProcessing" set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a SessionStopReq while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

V2G20-4056.text: [V2G20-4056] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP after receiving the SessionStopRes with "ResponseCode = OK" the EVCC shall stop all multiplexed communication.

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC is using DC_ACDP service and has received a successful SessionStopRes.
The EVCC shall stop all multiplexed communication after meeting the guard conditions.

V2G20-4057.text: [V2G20-4057] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, [V2G20-1482] does not apply.

atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that if the SECC is using DC_ACDP service, then the requirement V2G20-1482 does not apply during the session.

V2G20-4058.text: [V2G20-4058] In case of any exception handling the SECC shall continue the communication to the EVCC until the last message pair of the exception handling procedure has been executed.

atoms.notes: This atom captures the requirement that the SECC must continue communication with the EVCC until the final message pair of the exception handling procedure is completed.

V2G20-4059.text: [V2G20-4059] When SECC experiences an emergency situation, and EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204 the EVSE shall set CP state to E.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC is experiencing an emergency situation and the EVCC is using the specified service.
This action sets the CP state to E when the guard conditions are met.

V2G20-4060.text: [V2G20-4060] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204, the SECC shall allow a SessionStopReq in case no ACDP_ConnectReq has been received.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if no ACDP_ConnectReq has been received by the SECC.
This action specifies that the SECC shall allow a SessionStopReq under the given conditions.

V2G20-4061.text: [V2G20-4061] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204, the SECC shall allow receiving a ACDP_DisconnectReq after sending ACDP_ConnectDeviceRes, CableCheckRes, DC_ChargeLoopRes or PowerDeliveryRes.

atoms.notes: This sequence constraint specifies that after sending any of the listed responses, the SECC should be prepared to receive an ACDP_DisconnectReq.

V2G20-4062.text: [V2G20-4062] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204, after sending a message containing a "ResponseCode = FAILED" in SessionSetupRes or SupportedAppProtocolRes, the SECC shall behave according to the requirements defined in 7.4.

atoms.expr: behave according to requirements in section 7.4
atoms.notes: This action specifies that the SECC should follow the behavior defined in section 7.4 after the guards are met.

atoms.expr: after sending SessionSetupRes or SupportedAppProtocolRes with ResponseCode = 'FAILED'
atoms.notes: This sequence constraint ensures that the action only takes place after the specified messages have been sent with the given ResponseCode.

V2G20-4063.text: [V2G20-4063] For early association support the association status between EV and EVSE shall be considered as being correctly associated as long as the continuously updated PPD information provides the same EVID as received by the SDP request when the element PPD/P2PS of the SDP request was set to value "PPD on infrastructure" according to Table 23.

atoms.notes: Checks if the P2PS field in the SDP request is set to 'PPD on infrastructure'.
Ensures that the EVID in the continuously updated PPD information matches the EVID from the SDP request.
The association status between EV and EVSE is considered correctly associated as long as the above conditions hold.
Assumes that the PPD information is continuously updated throughout the session.

V2G20-4064.text: [V2G20-4064] For early association support the association status between EV and EVSE shall be continuously supervised by the SECC when the element PPD/P2PS of the SDP request was set to value "PPD on infrastructure" according to Table 23.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the PPD/P2PS element in the SDP request is set to 'PPD on infrastructure'.
The SECC shall continuously supervise the association status between the EV and EVSE.
The association status supervision must always be active when the condition is met.
It is assumed that the SDP request has been received and processed by the SECC.

V2G20-4065.text: [V2G20-4065] For early association support the SECC shall respond the latest V2G message request with the ResponseCode= FAILED_AssociationError when EV and EVSE are not correctly associated and then wait for a new SDP request when the element PPD/P2PS of the SDP request was set to value "PPD on infrastructure" according to Table 23.

atoms.notes: Checks if EV and EVSE are not correctly associated.
SECC sets ResponseCode to FAILED_AssociationError when not associated.
SECC waits for a new SDP request after sending FAILED_AssociationError.
Checks if PPD_P2PS is set to 'PPD on infrastructure' in the SDP request.

V2G20-4066.text: [V2G20-4066] For early association support the SECC shall stop the supervision of the association status after the ACDP_VehiclePositioning has been finished with ResponseCode = OK and EVSEProcessing=Finished when the element PPD/P2PS of the SDP request was set to value "PPD on infrastructure" according to Table 23.

atoms.notes: Checks if the ACDP_VehiclePositioning has completed successfully.
The SECC stops supervising the association status once the conditions are met.
Ensures that the action to stop association supervision occurs after receiving the ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes message.

V2G20-4067.text: [V2G20-4067] After receiving a SessionSetupReq, the SECC shall respond with a SessionSetupRes within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard indicates that the SECC has received a SessionSetupReq message.
The SECC is required to send a SessionSetupRes message in response to a SessionSetupReq.
The SECC must send the SessionSetupRes within the specified performance time.
According to Table 215, the ResponseCode in SessionSetupRes should be set to OK under normal circumstances.

V2G20-4068.text: [V2G20-4068] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, after receiving the ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq, the SECC shall respond with a ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215, while the vehicle positioning is still ongoing.

atoms.notes: Ensures that the SECC has received the ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq message.
Specifies that the SECC should send an ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to 'Ongoing'.
Ensures that the vehicle positioning process is still ongoing when the response is sent.

V2G20-4069.text: [V2G20-4069] After receiving a ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq with EVMobilityStatus set to "EV is immobilized", the SECC shall respond with a ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq has the EVMobilityStatus set to 'EV is immobilized'.
The SECC responds with an ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes setting EVSEProcessing to 'Finished'.

atoms.expr: EVSEProcessing is mandatory and its domain includes 'Finished'
atoms.notes: Ensures that EVSEProcessing is a mandatory field and can take the value 'Finished'.
Specifies the order of messages where ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes must follow ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq.

V2G20-4070.text: [V2G20-4070] After receiving the ScheduleExchangeReq, the SECC shall respond with a ScheduleExchangeRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" within

atoms.notes: The response must be sent within the specified timeout period.

V2G20-4071.text: [V2G20-4071] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, after receiving the ACDP_ConnectReq, the SECC shall respond with a ACDP_ConnectRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215 while the device connection is still ongoing.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC has received the ACDP_ConnectReq message.
The SECC shall send an ACDP_ConnectRes message with EVSEProcessing set to 'Ongoing'.
The device connection must be ongoing for this requirement to apply.

V2G20-4072.text: [V2G20-4072] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP, after receiving the ACDP_ConnectReq, the SECC shall respond with a ACDP_ConnectRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215, when the device connection has finished.

atoms.notes: The SECC shall send an ACDP_ConnectRes message with EVSEProcessing set to 'Finished'.
This guard ensures that the device connection has finished before sending the response.

V2G20-4073.text: [V2G20-4073] If SECC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204, after receiving the PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to "Stop", the SECC shall respond with PowerDeliveryRes containing "ResponseCode=OK" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: The SECC must send a PowerDeliveryRes message with ResponseCode set to 'OK'.

atoms.expr: ResponseCode is mandatory and its domain includes 'OK'
atoms.notes: Ensures that ResponseCode is a mandatory field and can take the value 'OK'.

V2G20-4074.text: [V2G20-4074] After receiving the ACDP_DisconnectReq, the SECC shall respond with ACDP_DisconnectRes containing "ResponseCode = OK" and "EVSEProcessing=Ongoing" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215, if the processing of the information is successfully passed and the ACDP_Disconnect is ongoing.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC has received the ACDP_DisconnectReq message.
The SECC sends an ACDP_DisconnectRes message with specific values for ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing.
The response must be sent within the specified timeout period.
Checks that the processing of the information was successful and the disconnect process is ongoing.
Ensures that the ResponseCode field is present and has the correct value.
Ensures that the EVSEProcessing field is present and has the correct value.

V2G20-4075.text: [V2G20-4075] After receiving the ACDP_DisconnectReq, the SECC shall respond with ACDP_DisconnectRes containing "ResponseCode = OK" and "EVSEProcessing=Finished" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215, if the charging device is in the home position as defined in IEC 61851-23-1.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the charging device is in the home position as per IEC 61851-23-1.
The SECC sends ACDP_DisconnectRes with specific values for ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing.
The response must be sent within the specified timeout period.

atoms.expr: ResponseCode is mandatory and equals OK
atoms.notes: Ensures the ResponseCode field is present and correctly set.

atoms.expr: EVSEProcessing is mandatory and equals Finished
atoms.notes: Ensures the EVSEProcessing field is present and correctly set.
Ensures the correct sequence of messages.
Assumes the home position is defined according to IEC 61851-23-1.

V2G20-4077.text: [V2G20-4077] In case more than 1 tag is used, The RFID reader PPD shall indicate sufficient positional accuracy information to support partitioning during the positioning process when it can correctly read at least n (number of tags) - 1 tags on the vehicle.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the requirement only applies when there are more than one tag.
The RFID reader PPD should indicate positional accuracy information.
The positional accuracy information must support partitioning.
The RFID reader must be able to correctly read at least n-1 tags.
The positional accuracy information must always be sufficient for the given number of tags.

V2G20-4079.text: [V2G20-4079] If EVCC is using ServiceName = DC_ACDP in Table 204, the EVCC shall send a SessionStopReq when "ResponseCode ≠ OK" of ScheduleExchangeRes".

V2G20-4101.text: [V2G20-4101] For pairing and positioning device support the SDP client shall reset the counter for sent SECC discovery request messages after a valid SECC discovery response message has been received with the payload parameter "DiagStatus = Ongoing".

V2G20-4102.text: [V2G20-4102] For wireless communication an SDP server shall send the SECC discovery response message with the payload parameter "DiagStatus = Ongoing" as long as no EVID is detected by the pairing and positioning device when the element PPD/P2PS of the SDP request was set to value "PPD on infrastructure" according to Table 24.

atoms.expr: PPD_P2PS == 'PPD on infrastructure' AND EVID_detected == false
atoms.notes: Checks if the PPD/P2PS field in the SDP request is set to 'PPD on infrastructure' and no EVID is detected.
Specifies that the SECC should send an SDP response with DiagStatus set to 'Ongoing'.

atoms.expr: DiagStatus is mandatory and its domain is {'Ongoing'}
atoms.notes: Ensures that the DiagStatus field is mandatory and can only have the value 'Ongoing'.
Assumes that the communication is wireless, which is a prerequisite for this requirement.

V2G20-4103.text: [V2G20-4103] For wireless communication an SDP server shall send the payload parameters SECC IP address and port number and DiagStatus set to "Finished with EVSEID" or "Finished without EVSEID" as soon as the EVID has been detected by the pairing and positioning device.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the EVID has been detected before proceeding.
The SECC sends the SDP response with the required fields.

atoms.expr: DiagStatus == 'Finished with EVSEID' OR DiagStatus == 'Finished without EVSEID'
atoms.notes: The DiagStatus field must be set to one of the specified values.
The SDP response should be sent immediately after EVID detection.

V2G20-4104.text: [V2G20-4104] For early association support an SDP server shall wait a random number of milliseconds that is smaller than 100 ms before sending the SECC discovery response message with the payload parameter "DiagStatus = Finished with EVSEID" or "DiagStatus = Finished without EVSEID" as long as no EVID has been received by the pairing and positioning device that matches with the EVID of the SDP request.

atoms.expr: not exists EVID_received_by_pairing_device such that EVID_received_by_pairing_device == SDP_Request.EVID
atoms.notes: Ensures that no matching EVID has been received.
The SECC waits for a random time less than 100 ms.

atoms.expr: send SECC_DiscoveryRes with DiagStatus = 'Finished with EVSEID' or DiagStatus = 'Finished without EVSEID'
atoms.notes: The SECC sends the discovery response with appropriate DiagStatus.
Ensures the DiagStatus field is correctly set.

V2G20-4105.text: [V2G20-4105] For early association support and when [V2G20-4104] applies an SDP server may abort a pending SDP response message related to an SDP request with EVID when recognizing an SDP response message of another SDP server containing the same EVID.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if there is an incoming SDP response from a different server with the same EVID.
The SECC aborts the pending SDP response related to the initial SDP request.
Assumes that the conditions specified in V2G20-4104 are met for this requirement to be applicable.
Ensures that the SDP response from another server is received after the initial SDP request was made.

V2G20-4106.text: [V2G20-4106] The XML schema with the namespace "urn:iso:std:iso:15118:-20:ACDP" shall be used for encoding and decoding EXI streams sent or received with Part20ACDPMainstreamPayloadID and defined in 8.3.4.7.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the correct XML schema namespace is used for encoding and decoding EXI streams.
This atom specifies that the EXI stream encoding is applied to messages with Part20ACDPMainstreamPayloadID.
This atom specifies that the EXI stream decoding is applied to messages with Part20ACDPMainstreamPayloadID.
This atom ensures that the Part20ACDPMainstreamPayloadID is defined according to section 8.3.4.7.

V2G20-4107.text: [V2G20-4107] If an EVCC supports the service ACDP and intends to offer it for this V2G communication session, it shall add an AppProtocol element to the supportedAppProtocolReq with ProtocolNamespace set to "urn:iso:std:iso:15118:20:ACDP", VersionNumberMajor set to "1" and VersionNumberMinor set to "0".

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC supports the ACDP service.
Ensures the ProtocolNamespace is correctly set for ACDP.
Ensures the major version number is set to 1.
Ensures the minor version number is set to 0.

V2G20-5001.text: [V2G20-5001] As long as EVProcessing is set to "Ongoing" the lists "EVDeviceFinePositioningMethodList", "EVDevicePairingMethodList", "EVDeviceAlignmentCheckMethodList" shall contain more than one element.

atoms.expr: if EVProcessing == 'Ongoing' then length(EVDeviceFinePositioningMethodList) > 1 and length(EVDevicePairingMethodList) > 1 and length(EVDeviceAlignmentCheckMethodList) > 1
atoms.notes: This invariant ensures that while processing is ongoing, certain method lists must have more than one element.

V2G20-5002.text: [V2G20-5002] If the lists "EVDeviceFinePositioningMethodList", "EVDevicePairingMethodList", "EVDeviceAlignmentCheckMethodList" contain more than one element, the default values shall be part of the list, if the device is a compatibility class A device (see IEC 61980-2 and IEC 61980-3).

atoms.notes: Checks if the lists contain more than one element.
Ensures the device is a compatibility class A device.

atoms.expr: default_value in EVDeviceFinePositioningMethodList && default_value in EVDevicePairingMethodList && default_value in EVDeviceAlignmentCheckMethodList
atoms.notes: Ensures default values are part of the lists if conditions are met.

V2G20-5003.text: [V2G20-5003] If the EVProcessing is set to "Finished", the lists shall contain only one element which represents the EV's choice.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVProcessing field is set to 'Finished'.
Ensures that when EVProcessing is 'Finished', the lists contain exactly one element.
Ensures that the single element in the lists represents the EV's choice.

atoms.expr: PrimaryDeviceFinePositioningMethodList != null && PrimaryDevicePairingMethodList != null && PrimaryDeviceAlignmentCheckMethodList != null
atoms.notes: This guard ensures that all three lists are present and not null.
Ensures that each list is of type LIST.
Ensures that each list is mandatory.
Ensures that each list has the correct domain.

V2G20-5007.text: [V2G20-5007] Both EVCC and SECC shall support the set of WPT pairing messages as described in 8.3.4.6.4, which are required to process the WPT pairing.

atoms.notes: Both EVCC and SECC must implement the specified WPT pairing messages.
The WPT pairing messages must be mandatory for processing.
The WPT pairing messages should follow the correct sequence as defined in the specification.
The support for WPT pairing messages must be consistent throughout the session.

V2G20-5008.text: [V2G20-5008] To start the pairing process the EVCC shall send a WPT_PairingReq message.

atoms.notes: This atom captures the action of the EVCC sending a WPT_PairingReq message to initiate the pairing process.

V2G20-5011.text: [V2G20-5011] The EVCC and the SECC shall implement the message elements as defined in Figure 74 and Table 70.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that both EVCC and SECC implement the message elements according to the specified figure and table.

V2G20-5012.text: [V2G20-5012] If the EVCC has identified a pairing code it shall send a WPT_PairingReq message with the parameter ObservedIDCode set to the pairing identification code and the EVProcessing parameter set to "Finished".

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC has successfully identified a pairing code.
The ObservedIDCode field in the WPT_PairingReq message must be set to the pairing identification code.
The EVProcessing field in the WPT_PairingReq message must be set to 'Finished'.

V2G20-5013.text: [V2G20-5013] The EVCC and the SECC shall implement the message elements as defined in Figure 75 and Table 71.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that both EVCC and SECC implement the message elements as specified in the referenced figure and table.

V2G20-5014.text: [V2G20-5014] The EVCC and the SECC shall implement the message elements as defined in Figure 81 and Table 77.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that both EVCC and SECC implement the message elements according to the specified figure and table.

V2G20-5015.text: [V2G20-5015] The EVCC and the SECC shall implement the message elements as defined in Figure 80 and Table 76.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that all message elements implemented by both EVCC and SECC adhere to the definitions provided in Figure 80 and Table 76.
This atom ensures that the mandatory/optional status of each message element is correctly implemented according to Figure 80 and Table 76.
This atom ensures that the domain constraints for each message element are correctly implemented according to Figure 80 and Table 76.

V2G20-5016.text: [V2G20-5016] If the SECC has received the WPT_PairingReq message with the parameter ObservedIDCode set to a pairing identification code and the validation of the

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC has received the WPT_PairingReq message with the correct ObservedIDCode.
The SECC shall validate the pairing identification code received in the WPT_PairingReq message.
The ObservedIDCode field in the WPT_PairingReq message should be of type String and mandatory.
After receiving and validating the WPT_PairingReq, the next allowed response from the SECC is WPT_PairingRes.

V2G20-5017.text: [V2G20-5017] If the SECC has received the WPT_PairingReq message with the parameter ObservedIDCode set to a pairing identification code and the validation of the ObservedIDCode succeeds it shall respond with a WPT_PairingRes message with the parameter ResponseCode equal to "OK".

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the ObservedIDCode in the WPT_PairingReq message matches a valid pairing identification code.
This action specifies that the SECC should send a WPT_PairingRes message with the ResponseCode set to 'OK'.
This field constraint ensures that the ResponseCode field in the WPT_PairingRes message is mandatory and can only take values 'OK' or 'FAILED'.

atoms.expr: WPT_PairingRes follows WPT_PairingReq when ObservedIDCode validation succeeds
atoms.notes: This sequence constraint ensures that the WPT_PairingRes message is sent by the SECC after receiving and successfully validating the ObservedIDCode in the WPT_PairingReq message.

V2G20-5018.text: [V2G20-5018] If the SECC has identified a pairing code it shall respond to a WPT_PairingReq with a WPT_PairingRes message with the parameter ObservedIDCode set to the pairing identification code and the EVSEProcessing parameter set to "Finished".

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC has successfully identified a pairing code.
The SECC shall send a WPT_PairingRes message in response to a WPT_PairingReq.
The ObservedIDCode field in the WPT_PairingRes message must be set to the pairing identification code.
The EVSEProcessing field in the WPT_PairingRes message must be set to 'Finished'.

V2G20-5019.text: [V2G20-5019] The EVCC shall send the WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message with the elements of the message set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.

atoms.notes: The EVCC is required to send the WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message.
The EVCharacteristics field must be set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.
The EVPowerDeliveryCapability field must be set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.
The EVPowerTransferMethodSelection field must be set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.
The EVMaxVoltageLimit field must be set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.
The EVMaxCurrentLimit field must be set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.
The EVMaxPowerLimit field must be set according to the technical characteristics of the EV device.

V2G20-5021.text: [V2G20-5021] The SECC shall respond with a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes with the ResponseCode = OK when the element values received from the EVCC allow a system setup for successful power transfer at the supply device.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received element values from the EVCC allow for a successful power transfer setup.
The SECC sends a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message with ResponseCode set to OK.
Ensures that the ResponseCode field in the WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message is set to OK.

V2G20-5022.text: [V2G20-5022] The SECC shall respond with a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes with the ResponseCode = FAILED when the element values received from the EVCC do not allow a system setup for any power transfer at the supply device.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received element values from the EVCC do not allow setting up the system for power transfer.
The SECC sends a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message with ResponseCode set to FAILED.
Ensures that the ResponseCode field in the WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message is set to FAILED.

V2G20-5023.text: [V2G20-5023] After receiving a WPT\_AlignmentCheckRes, the EVCC shall not send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to "Standby".

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that after receiving a WPT_AlignmentCheckRes, the EVCC does not send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Standby'.

V2G20-5024.text: [V2G20-5024] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningReq or a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the ResponseCode is OK before proceeding.
The EVCC must send either a WPT_FinePositioningReq or a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq.
According to Table 218, these are the next allowed requests after receiving WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes.

V2G20-5025.text: [V2G20-5025] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningReq with EVProcessing set to "Ongoing" while the vehicle positioning is still ongoing within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the conditions on the received response before the EVCC takes any action.
The EVCC sends a new request with the specified processing status.

atoms.expr: WPT_FinePositioningReq.EVProcessing is mandatory and its value is 'Ongoing'
atoms.notes: Ensures the correct field is present and has the expected value in the sent message.
Specifies the order of messages in the communication sequence.

V2G20-5026.text: [V2G20-5026] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished" when the vehicle positioning is finished within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends a new request indicating that positioning is complete.

atoms.expr: EVProcessing is mandatory and its domain includes 'Finished'
atoms.notes: Ensures the correct field is present and valid in the message.
Specifies the order of messages in the communication sequence.

V2G20-5027.text: [V2G20-5027] After sending a WPT_FinePositioningReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished", and receiving the next response message with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a WPT_PairingReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVProcessing field in the WPT_FinePositioningReq message is set to 'Finished'.
Ensures that sending WPT_PairingReq is the next allowed request after the conditions are met.
The service status must not be NotAvailable at any point.

atoms.expr: SECC is ready to process SVCDiscoveryRes
atoms.notes: It is assumed that the SECC is in a state where it can process the SVCDiscoveryRes message.

V2G20-5029.text: [V2G20-5029] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a WPT_PairingReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: Checks if the received WPT_FinePositioningRes has the correct ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing values.
The WPT_PairingReq must be sent within the specified timeout period.
Ensures that WPT_PairingReq follows WPT_FinePositioningRes in the message sequence.

V2G20-5030.text: [V2G20-5030] After receiving a WPT_PairingRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing = "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a WPT_PairingReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

V2G20-5031.text: [V2G20-5031] After receiving the WPT_PairingRes with "ResponseCode = OK" and EVSEProcessing = "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a WPT_PairingReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished" within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 190 if the pairing process is finished (see also [V2G20-5012]).

atoms.notes: Checks the conditions after receiving WPT_PairingRes.
Ensures the pairing process is finished before sending WPT_PairingReq.
Specifies the action of sending WPT_PairingReq with EVProcessing set to 'Finished'.

V2G20-5032.text: [V2G20-5032] After sending a WPT_PairingReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished", and receiving the next response message with ResponseCode = "OK", the EVCC shall send an AuthorizationSetupReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Specifies the order of messages: WPT_PairingRes must precede AuthorizationSetupReq.

V2G20-5033.text: [V2G20-5033] After receiving a WPT_PairingRes with ResponseCode = "OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a WPT_PairingReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: Ensures the correct sequence of messages according to the protocol.

V2G20-5034.text: [V2G20-5034] After receiving a WPT_PairingRes with "ResponseCode = OK", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send an AuthorizationSetupReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the conditions on the received WPT_PairingRes message.
This constraint specifies the order of messages, indicating that AuthorizationSetupReq should follow WPT_PairingRes under the given conditions.

V2G20-5035.text: [V2G20-5035] After receiving a WPT_AlignmentCheckRes with ResponseCode = "OK", and EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing", the EVCC shall send a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: Checks if the received WPT_AlignmentCheckRes has the correct ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing values.
The EVCC sends a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq after meeting the specified conditions.
The WPT_AlignmentCheckReq must be sent within the specified timeout period.
Ensures the correct sequence of messages according to the protocol.

V2G20-5036.text: [V2G20-5036] After sending a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished", and received the next response message with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Specifies the order of messages: WPT_AlignmentCheckRes must precede PowerDeliveryReq.

V2G20-5037.text: [V2G20-5037] If EVCC uses ServiceName = WPT from Table 204, after receiving the PowerDeliveryRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send an WPT_ChargeLoopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218 to start the energy transfer.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVCC is using the WPT service.
The EVCC shall send a WPT_ChargeLoopReq message.
The fields in WPT_ChargeLoopReq must comply with the specifications in Table 218.
The WPT_ChargeLoopReq should be sent next after receiving PowerDeliveryRes.

V2G20-5039.text: [V2G20-5039] If the EVCC wants to continue the energy transfer and received the WPT_ChargeLoopRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send another WPT_ChargeLoopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: Checks if EVCC wants to continue and received an OK response.
Ensures that sending WPT_ChargeLoopReq is the next allowed request based on Table 218.

V2G20-5040.text: [V2G20-5040] If EVCC is using ServiceName = WPT in Table 204, after receiving the PowerDeliveryRes with "ResponseCode = OK", and if the previous PowerDeliveryReq message has ChargeProgress = "Stop", the EVCC shall send a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

V2G20-5041.text: [V2G20-5041] If the EVCC is using ServiceName = WPT, after receiving the ServiceSelectionRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: The WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq should be sent after receiving ServiceSelectionRes.

V2G20-5042.text: [V2G20-5042] If the EVCC is using the WPT module, after receiving the SessionSetupRes with "ResponseCode = OK", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Checks if the WPT module is used and the ResponseCode is OK in SessionSetupRes.
The EVCC sends a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq message.
Ensures that sending WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq is the next allowed request after receiving SessionSetupRes.

V2G20-5043.text: [V2G20-5043] After receiving a SessionSetupReq, the SECC shall respond with a SessionSetupRes within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard indicates that the SECC has received a SessionSetupReq message.
The SECC is required to send a SessionSetupRes message in response to a SessionSetupReq.
The SECC must send the SessionSetupRes within the specified performance time.
The SessionSetupRes must be sent immediately after receiving the SessionSetupReq.

V2G20-5044.text: [V2G20-5044] After receiving the ScheduleExchangeReq, the SECC shall respond with a ScheduleExchangeRes within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: The SECC is required to send a ScheduleExchangeRes message in response to the ScheduleExchangeReq.

V2G20-5045.text: [V2G20-5045] After receiving a ScheduleExchangeRes with ResponseCode = "OK" and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" the EVCC shall send a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures the conditions under which the EVCC should proceed.
The EVCC is required to send a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq after the specified conditions are met.
Ensures the correct sequence of messages between ScheduleExchangeRes and WPT_AlignmentCheckReq.

V2G20-5046.text: NOTE 7 In this case the EVCC will follow [V2G20-2097], [V2G20-2098] or [V2G20-5046], depending on the energy transfer mode selected.

atoms.expr: if EnergyTransferModeSelected then follow(V2G20-2097) or follow(V2G20-2098) or follow(V2G20-5046)
atoms.notes: This atom captures the conditional behavior of the EVCC based on the selected energy transfer mode.
This guard ensures that the energy transfer mode is either AC or DC before proceeding with the specified requirements.

V2G20-5048.text: [V2G20-5048] If the EVProcessing element in WPT_AlignmentCheckReq is set to "Finished" the EVResultCode shall not be set to "EVResultUnknown".

atoms.notes: This field constraint ensures that EVResultCode is not set to 'EVResultUnknown' when EVProcessing is 'Finished'.

V2G20-5049.text: [V2G20-5049] As long as the EVProcessing Element in WPT_PairingReq is "Ongoing" the EVResultCode shall be set to "EVResultUnknown".

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVProcessing element in the WPT_PairingReq message is set to 'Ongoing'.
This action sets the EVResultCode to 'EVResultUnknown' when the guard condition is met.
This invariant ensures that whenever EVProcessing is 'Ongoing', EVResultCode is always 'EVResultUnknown'.

V2G20-5050.text: [V2G20-5050] If the EVProcessing element in WPT_PairingReq is set to "Finished" the EVResultCode shall not be set to "EVResultUnknown".

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the EVProcessing element in WPT_PairingReq is set to 'Finished'.
This field constraint ensures that if the guard condition is met, the EVResultCode in WPT_PairingRes shall not be set to 'EVResultUnknown'.

V2G20-5052.text: [V2G20-5052] If the EVProcessing element in WPT_FinePositioningReq is set to "Finished" the EVResultCode shall not be set to "EVResultUnknown".

atoms.notes: This constraint ensures that when EVProcessing is 'Finished', EVResultCode cannot be 'EVResultUnknown'.

V2G20-5053.text: [V2G20-5053] If [V2G20-5016] applies or the EVCC sent a WPT_PairingReq with the parameter EVResultCode set to "EVResultFailed, then the SECC should include AlternativeSECCList parameter in the PairingRes message when such information is available.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if either V2G20-5016 applies or the EVResultCode in WPT_PairingReq is set to 'EVResultFailed'.
The SECC should include the AlternativeSECCList parameter in the PairingRes message if the above guard condition is met.
The AlternativeSECCList parameter should be included only if such information is available.

V2G20-5054.text: [V2G20-5054] After receiving a WPT_PairingRes with ResponseCode = "WARNING_WPT", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupSetupReq or terminate by sending a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received WPT_PairingRes has the specified ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing values.
The EVCC must either send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or a SessionStopReq based on the conditions met.
This ensures that the next allowed request after receiving WPT_PairingRes is either WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or SessionStopReq.

V2G20-5055.text: [V2G20-5055] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningRes with "ResponseCode = WARNING_WPT" and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or terminate by sending a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: This guard checks the conditions specified in the requirement.
The next allowed requests after receiving the specified response are WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or SessionStopReq.

V2G20-5056.text: [V2G20-5056] If the SECC has received the WPT_FinePositioningReq message with the parameter EVResultCode set to a "EVResultFailed" it shall respond with a WPT_FinePositioningRes message with the parameter ResponseCode equal to FAILED or WARNING_WPT.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC has received a WPT_FinePositioningReq message with EVResultCode set to EVResultFailed.
The SECC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningRes message with ResponseCode set to either FAILED or WARNING_WPT.
The ResponseCode field in the WPT_FinePositioningRes message must be either FAILED or WARNING_WPT.

V2G20-5057.text: [V2G20-5057] After receiving a WPT_AlignmentCheckRes with ResponseCode = "WARNING_WPT", and EVSEProcessing set to "Finished", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or terminate by sending a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received WPT_AlignmentCheckRes has the specified ResponseCode and EVSEProcessing values.

V2G20-5058.text: [V2G20-5058] After receiving a WPT_ChargeLoopRes with "ResponseCode = WARNING_WPT", the EVCC shall send a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq or a WPT_PairingReq or terminate by sending a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the ResponseCode in the received WPT_ChargeLoopRes is WARNING_WPT.
The EVCC must choose to send either a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq, a WPT_PairingReq, or a SessionStopReq.
This constraint ensures that only the specified messages can be sent next after receiving the WPT_ChargeLoopRes with WARNING_WPT.

V2G20-5059.text: [V2G20-5059] The SECC shall implement the ServiceParameterList for WPT service as defined in Table 209.

atoms.expr: ServiceParameterList contains parameters as defined in Table 209 when ServiceID = WPT
atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the ServiceParameterList for WPT service is correctly implemented according to the specifications in Table 209.

V2G20-5060.text: [V2G20-5060] When the EVCC wants to enter a standby period, after having received WPT_ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with parameter ChargeProgress set to "Standby", while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the EVCC has received the WPT_ChargeLoopRes message before proceeding.
This action specifies that the EVCC should send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Standby'.
This field constraint ensures that the ChargeProgress field in PowerDeliveryReq is set to 'Standby'.

V2G20-5061.text: [V2G20-5061] If EVCC uses ServiceName = WPT from Table 204, after receiving the PowerDeliveryRes with "ResponseCode = WARNING_WPT", the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or terminate by sending a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: Checks if the ServiceName is WPT and the ResponseCode is WARNING_WPT.

V2G20-5062.text: [V2G20-5062] After receiving a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes with ResponseCode = "WARNING_WPT" the EVCC shall send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or terminate by sending a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes has a ResponseCode of WARNING_WPT.
The EVCC must either send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or a SessionStopReq after receiving WARNING_WPT.
This ensures that only WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq or SessionStopReq can be sent next.

V2G20-5064.text: [V2G20-5064] After receiving the PowerDeliveryRes with ResponseCode equal to "OK" as a response to a previous PowerDeliveryReq message with ChargeProgress equal to "Standby", the EVCC shall send a WPT_ChargeLoopReq with PowerRequest set to zero, while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: The EVCC sends a WPT_ChargeLoopReq with PowerRequest set to zero.

V2G20-5065.text: [V2G20-5065] If the SECC has received the WPT_PairingReq message with the parameter EVResultCode set to "EVResultFailed", then the SECC shall respond with a WPT_PairingRes message with the parameter ResponseCode equal to FAILED or WARNING_WPT.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the SECC has received a WPT_PairingReq message with EVResultCode set to 'EVResultFailed'.

atoms.expr: send WPT_PairingRes with ResponseCode == 'FAILED' or ResponseCode == 'WARNING_WPT'
atoms.notes: The SECC shall respond with a WPT_PairingRes message setting the ResponseCode to either 'FAILED' or 'WARNING_WPT'.

V2G20-5066.text: [V2G20-5066] The SECC shall respond with a WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes with the ResponseCode = WARNING_WPT when the element values received from the EVCC only allow a system setup for limited (significantly lower) power transfer at the supply device.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the received element values from the EVCC only allow for limited power transfer.
The SECC responds with a WARNING_WPT ResponseCode when the condition is met.

atoms.expr: WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes.ResponseCode is mandatory and of type ResponseCodeType
atoms.notes: Ensures the ResponseCode field is present and correctly typed.

V2G20-5067.text: [V2G20-5067] After receiving one of the messages WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes, WPT_FinePositioningRes, WPT_PairingRes, WPT_AlignmentCheckRes, WPT_ChargeLoopRes with ResponseCode = FAILED the EVCC shall send a SessionStopReq within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 218 to terminate the session.

atoms.expr: (Message = WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes OR Message = WPT_FinePositioningRes OR Message = WPT_PairingRes OR Message = WPT_AlignmentCheckRes OR Message = WPT_ChargeLoopRes) AND ResponseCode = FAILED
atoms.notes: This guard checks if any of the specified messages have been received with a ResponseCode of FAILED.
The EVCC shall send a SessionStopReq message to terminate the session.
The SessionStopReq must be sent within the specified timeout period.

atoms.expr: SessionStopReq follows (WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes OR WPT_FinePositioningRes OR WPT_PairingRes OR WPT_AlignmentCheckRes OR WPT_ChargeLoopRes) with ResponseCode = FAILED
atoms.notes: The SessionStopReq must follow the receipt of one of the specified messages with a ResponseCode of FAILED.

V2G20-5068.text: [V2G20-5068] When the EVCC wants to exit a standby period, after having received WPT_ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to "Start", "Stop" or "ScheduleRenegotiation" while V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Timer is smaller than V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Time.

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC wants to exit the standby period and has received WPT_ChargeLoopRes.
The EVCC sends a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress set to 'Start', 'Stop', or 'ScheduleRenegotiation'.

V2G20-5069.text: [V2G20-5069] The EVCC shall implement the EVCC specific WPT timeouts and performance times defined in Table 218.

atoms.expr: WPT_Timeouts AND Performance_Times AS DEFINED IN TABLE 218
atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the EVCC implements the specific WPT timeouts and performance times as defined in Table 218.

V2G20-5070.text: [V2G20-5070] The SECC shall implement the SECC specific WPT timeouts and performance times defined in Table 218.

atoms.notes: This atom ensures that the SECC implements the specific WPT timeouts and performance times as defined in Table 218.

V2G20-5071.text: [V2G20-5071] An ISO 15118-enabled EV shall conform to IEC 61980-2 and ISO 19363:2020.

atoms.notes: This atom captures the requirement that the EV must adhere to the specified standards globally.

V2G20-5072.text: [V2G20-5072] During HLC-C, the EV shall apply all energy transfer limits as negotiated by the ISO 15118 series in addition to the limits defined by IEC 61980-2.

atoms.notes: Ensures the requirement applies during the High-Level Control - Charging state.
The EV shall apply the energy transfer limits negotiated according to ISO 15118.
The EV shall also apply the energy transfer limits defined by IEC 61980-2.
Ensures that both sets of energy transfer limits are always applied during HLC-C.

V2G20-5073.text: [V2G20-5073] ISO 15118-enabled EVSE shall conform to IEC 61980-2.

atoms.notes: This atom represents the assumption that the SECC conforms to IEC 61980-2 as required by V2G20-5073.

V2G20-5074.text: [V2G20-5074] The message "PowerDeliveryRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "WARNING_WPT" after the supply device has detected an alignment error or other anomaly.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the supply device has detected an alignment error or another anomaly.
The SECC sets the ResponseCode to WARNING_WPT when an alignment error or anomaly is detected.
Ensures that the ResponseCode field is mandatory and its value is set to WARNING_WPT.

V2G20-5075.text: [V2G20-5075] The message "WPT_ChargeLoopRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "WARNING_WPT" after the supply device has detected an alignment error or other anomaly.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the supply device has detected an alignment error or another anomaly.
The SECC sets the ResponseCode to WARNING_WPT when an alignment error or anomaly is detected.

V2G20-5076.text: [V2G20-5076] The message "WPT_ChargeLoopRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "FAILED" after the supply device has detected an unrecoverable error or exception.

atoms.notes: This guard checks if the supply device has detected an unrecoverable error.
This action sets the ResponseCode to 'FAILED' when the guard condition is met.

atoms.expr: ResponseCode is mandatory and its domain includes 'FAILED'
atoms.notes: Ensures that ResponseCode is a mandatory field with 'FAILED' as a valid value.

V2G20-5077.text: [V2G20-5077] The message "WPT_AlignmentCheckRes" shall contain the ResponseCode "WARNING_WPT" after the supply device has detected an alignment error.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the supply device has detected an alignment error before sending the response.
The SECC sets the ResponseCode to WARNING_WPT when an alignment error is detected.
Ensures that the WPT_AlignmentCheckRes message is sent in response to a WPT_AlignmentCheckReq message.

V2G20-5078.text: [V2G20-1864] If a PowerTolerance band was defined (see [V2G20-1870]), then the SECC shall issue a "WARNING_EVPowerProfileViolation", as defined in [V2G20-1947], [V2G20-1948] and [V2G20-5078], whenever the applied power is outside the presently valid boundaries of the PowerTolerance band.

V2G20-5079.text: [V2G20-1865] If a PowerTolerance band was defined (see [V2G20-1870]), then the SECC shall issue a "FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation", as defined in [V2G20-1950], [V2G20-1951] and [V2G20-5079], whenever the arithmetic average of the applied power over a time period of the last 30 s is outside the presently valid boundaries of the PowerTolerance band.

atoms.notes: Ensures the average applied power is within the PowerTolerance band limits.
Specifies the time period over which the average applied power is calculated.
The SECC issues a 'FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation' response code when the average applied power is outside the PowerTolerance band.

atoms.expr: if (PowerToleranceBandDefined == true && !(PowerToleranceBand.lowerLimit <= AverageAppliedPower && AverageAppliedPower <= PowerToleranceBand.upperLimit)) then ResponseCode == FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation
atoms.notes: Ensures that if a PowerTolerance band is defined and the average applied power is outside its boundaries, the SECC responds with 'FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation'.

V2G20-5080.text: [V2G20-5080] If the first ServiceDiscoveryRes message of the service session had the parameter ServiceRenegotiationSupported set to "True" and if the parameter EVSENotification in EVSEStatus is equal to "ServiceRenegotiation" WPT_ChargeLoopRes, the EVCC shall initiate a ServiceRenegotiation as defined by [V2G20-1661] within the number of seconds provided in NotificationMaxDelay.

atoms.notes: Checks the conditions for initiating a ServiceRenegotiation.
Ensures the SECC indicates a need for ServiceRenegotiation.
After the conditions are met, the next allowed request is ServiceRenegotiationReq.

V2G20-5081.text: [V2G20-5081] If the first ServiceDiscoveryRes message of the service session had the parameter ServiceRenegotiationSupported set to "False" and if the parameter EVSENotification in EVSEStatus is equal to "ServiceRenegotiation" in WPT_ChargeLoopRes, the EVC shall not initiate a ServiceRenegotiation.

atoms.notes: This guard checks the conditions specified in the requirement.

V2G20-5082.text: [V2G20-5082] If the EVCC wants to stop the energy transfer and received the WPT_ChargeLoopRes with "ResponseCode = OK" the EVCC shall send a PowerDeliveryReq with ChargeProgress = "Stop" within V2G_EVCC_Sequence_Performance_Timeout according to Table 215.

atoms.notes: Checks if the EVCC wants to stop energy transfer and has received a successful WPT_ChargeLoopRes.

V2G20-5085.text: [V2G20-5085] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq, the SECC shall respond with a WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC has received the WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq message.
The SECC is required to send a WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes message in response.
The response must be sent within the specified timeout period.
The fields in the WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes message must conform to the specifications in Table 218.

V2G20-5086.text: [V2G20-5086] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningReq with EVProcessing set to "Finished", the SECC shall respond with a WPT_FinePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 218.

atoms.notes: The SECC must send a WPT_FinePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to 'Finished'.

atoms.expr: WPT_FinePositioningRes must be sent within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time after receiving WPT_FinePositioningReq
atoms.notes: The response must be sent within the specified timeout.

atoms.expr: WPT_FinePositioningRes.EVSEProcessing is mandatory and its domain includes 'Finished'
atoms.notes: Ensures the correct field type and domain for EVSEProcessing.

V2G20-5087.text: [V2G20-5087] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningReq with EVProcessing set to "Ongoing", the SECC shall respond with a WPT_FinePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Ongoing" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 218, while the vehicle positioning is still ongoing.

atoms.notes: This guard ensures that the SECC only responds when the EVProcessing is set to 'Ongoing'.
The SECC must send a WPT_FinePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to 'Ongoing'.
The response must be sent within the specified timeout.
The vehicle positioning must be ongoing during this process.

V2G20-5088.text: [V2G20-5088] After receiving a WPT_FinePositioningReq with EVProcessing set to "Ongoing", the SECC shall respond with a WPT_FinePositioningRes with EVSEProcessing set to "Finished" within V2G_SECC_Msg_Performance_Time according to Table 218, when the vehicle positioning has finished.
